description: Incorporating Climate Change into the Casco Bay Estuary Partnership is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Climate Adaptation Knowledge Exchange (CAKE); Casco Bay Estuary Partnership; EPA Climate Ready Estuaries Program. The Casco Bay Estuary Partnership (CBEP) was one of the first National Estuary Programs to receive a technical assistance grant from the Climate Ready Estuaries Program. This initial grant elevated climate change as a major concern to the Partnership and CBEP began mainstreaming resilience into its efforts. Coverage: Portland, ME (2016). The toolkit gives Portland, ME as the location, 2016 as the year and 5 years as the duration. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
